# Point Zero

> Point Zero is the AI & software engineering partner for ambitious teams in Nepal and worldwide. We ship production-grade AI agents, RAG chatbots, web apps and mobile apps for startups and enterprises. Based in Kathmandu, Nepal — working with clients across the US, UK, UAE and India.

**Founded:** 2022  ·  **Location:** Kathmandu, Nepal  ·  **Working area:** Worldwide
**Contact:** hi.pointzero@gmail.com  ·  +977-9860486269  ·  WhatsApp: +977-9860486269
**Website:** https://pointzero.com.np
**Rating:** ★ 5.0 (32 client reviews)

## What Point Zero does

- AI & RAG software development — retrieval-augmented chatbots, AI agents, document & PDF extraction, multi-step LLM workflows
- RAG chatbot development — hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, hallucination evals, inline citations
- Web development — marketing websites, web apps, SaaS platforms and APIs on React, Next.js, Django, Node.js, PostgreSQL
- Mobile app development — iOS and Android with Flutter, React Native, Swift and Kotlin
- MVP development for startups — Lean Canvas to launched product in 8–10 weeks
- UI / UX design — research, design systems, conversion-focused interfaces
- Software QA, testing, DevOps and dedicated developer teams

## AI / RAG capabilities (in detail)

- Models: Anthropic Claude (default), OpenAI GPT-4o, Google Gemini, open Llama 3 — chosen per use case after benchmarking on client evals
- Orchestration: LangChain, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, custom agent loops with tool use
- Vector databases: pgvector (Postgres), Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant — recommend pgvector under 5M chunks
- Retrieval: hybrid BM25 + dense, cross-encoder re-ranking, query rewriting, grounded generation with citations
- Patterns: RAG over docs/websites/DBs, AI customer support, multi-step agents, document extraction, LoRA fine-tuning, prompt libraries, golden-set + online evals
- Production: caching, observability (Langfuse, Phoenix), model routing, cost controls, SLAs, private VPC deploys

## Pricing (typical ranges)

- Marketing website: from USD 1,500 — 2 to 4 weeks
- RAG chatbot pilot: from USD 3,000 — 2 to 3 weeks
- Mobile app MVP: from USD 2,500 — 6 to 10 weeks
- Startup MVP (web + auth + billing + admin): from USD 6,000 — 8 to 10 weeks
- Production AI software: USD 8,000 to USD 40,000 — 6 to 16 weeks

## Why teams pick Point Zero

- We ship — most websites in 2–4 weeks, RAG pilots in 2–3 weeks, MVPs in 8–10 weeks
- We measure — every release is tied to a conversion, quality or eval metric
- We stay — monthly support and growth retainers post-launch
- We are honest about cost — fixed-price or T&M with milestones after a free discovery call
- We are senior — engineers on the build, not interns
- We are local — Kathmandu HQ, English-first comms, in your time zone
